purpose: Replace the saturated binary/exact-scope utility used by HIST-STICKY-ONLINE-v2.1 with a prospectively fixed discriminator that still enforces strict Phase-1-v4 acceptance but can penalize generic controller wrappers that erase the public mechanism being audited.

fatal_gates.name: zero_residual_external_execution
fatal_gates.pass: No richer-mode, protected-primary, manual-user or external executor step remains on the accepted route.

fatal_gates.name: zero_optional_quota_and_cost
fatal_gates.pass: No finite monthly/trial/paid/cloud/API/model quota is required and incremental monetary cost is zero.

fatal_gates.name: boundary_integrity
fatal_gates.pass: Root acceptance, CLEAN semantic-input boundary, authority/topology, write namespace, credit policy and sealed factual/counterfactual identity remain immutable.

fatal_gates.name: durable_evidence_identity
fatal_gates.pass: Terminal evidence has a stable role-local identity and successful readback before reward/credit or selector observation.

fatal_gates.name: bounded_exit
fatal_gates.pass: The adaptation has an explicit bounded stop/switch/fail-closed transition; indefinite self-loop without evidence is not accepted.

fatal_gates.name: allowed_provenance
fatal_gates.pass: Semantic evidence comes only from own CLEAN state, public sources and own sanitized feedback; source-specific claims are traceable.

fatal_rule: If any fatal gate fails, utility=0 and component scores are reported for diagnosis only, never used to override the failure.

anchors.0: Only a generic controller/safety wrapper remains; source name could be swapped with no semantic change.
anchors.1: One distinctive source operator is retained but its state/evaluation relation is collapsed.
anchors.2: At least two source-distinctive operators are retained, or one distinctive operator plus its source-specific state/evaluation relation.
anchors.3: Source-specific operator(s), state/evaluation relation and at least one source-specific failure mode or ablation are all preserved in the Chat-native reduction.

anchors.0: Covers none of switching, recovery, credit/evidence transitions.
anchors.1: Covers exactly one of switching, recovery, credit/evidence transitions.
anchors.2: Covers exactly two with explicit transitions.
anchors.3: Covers all three with explicit transitions and no hidden executor.

anchors.0: Positive conformance only or no negative control.
anchors.1: At least one predeclared negative/ablation exposes a failure.
anchors.2: At least two independent negatives, including one tied to the transferred mechanism rather than only generic safety.
anchors.3: At least three independent negatives and at least one mechanism-specific ablation whose unguarded outcome differs from the guarded outcome.

anchors.0: Undurable assertion or no reproducible trace.
anchors.2: Constructed controls plus immutable evidence/readback/provenance and independently sealed terminal outcome.
anchors.3: Level 2 plus a fresh natural cross-invocation or real same-scope outcome not generated solely to satisfy this rubric.

utility_rule: If all fatal gates pass, utility = MF + TC + FS + EV, integer range 0..12. No weights, thresholds or anchors may be changed after observing candidate scores in this calibration cycle.
selector_use_rule: Historical binary utilities remain immutable historical records. This rubric is prospective; do not retroactively rewrite prior round outcomes. A future selector comparison may use CHAT-MECHANISM-DISCRIMINATION-v1 only after at least one sealed factual outcome per policy has been scored under the unchanged rubric.

constructed_controls_predeclared.expected: all generic safety guards may pass, but MF=0 because the public mechanism is erased; utility cannot exceed TC+FS+EV.
G1 or G2 fails; utility=0 regardless of mechanism fidelity.

A zero-dependency Chat-native reduction preserving source-specific operators plus task transitions, mechanism-specific ablation and durable outcome should pass all gates and score at least MF=2, TC=3, FS=2, EV=2.

A safe zero-dependency reduction retaining only one distinctive operator with collapsed source state/evaluation relation should pass gates but score MF=1, demonstrating separation from faithful transfer.

anti_gaming: Do not add a source-specific operator after seeing its rubric score unless it is evaluated as a new independently sealed candidate/outcome.
Do not count the same negative trace twice under different labels.
Do not award EV=3 for constructed guard cases created solely for this rubric.
Do not infer counterfactual scores for unread candidates.
Do not convert transport failures into semantic failures or rewards.
Do not use rubric score alone as global Phase-1 completion evidence.
exact_next_action: Execute the seven predeclared constructed controls without modifying the rubric. Then apply the unchanged rubric only to already-sealed own Reflexion and TEMPERA evidence as diagnostic prospective examples; do not rewrite rounds 11/12. If controls separate the intended cases, seal a hardened calibration checkpoint and use the rubric prospectively in later balanced selector exposures.
